planning_notes: Board is Arduino UNO (arduino:avr:uno). LM35 analog temperature sensor is wired to A2 as the only explicitly supplied pin.
Serial baud is fixed at 9600; framing uses the assumed default line_or_idle with idle_timeout_ms=20 (no explicit framing override provided by requirements).

LM35-to-°C scaling/conversion and report cadence are handled in the SysML model using elapsed_ms; this device request only registers the A2 analog acquisition and the Serial numeric reporting gate/value.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: LM35 temperature sensor ADC input for serial °C reporting

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Business report condition for periodically sending the current temperature in °C over Serial
